hotel_info.name: Harbor View Hotel
hotel_info.description: Harbor View Hotel is a premier 5-star beachfront resort overlooking the sapphire waters of the bay. Offering serene hospitality, world-class dining, and elegant modern suites.

rooms.name: Deluxe King Suite
rooms.description: Spacious luxury room featuring a plush King bed, private balcony with ocean views, marble bathroom with rain shower, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

rooms.name: Deluxe Twin Room
rooms.description: Comfortable and stylish room with two Queen beds, garden view, desk workspace, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

rooms.name: Deluxe Family Suite
rooms.description: Ideal for families or groups of up to 4. Includes a master King bedroom, separate living space with convertible sofa bed, dual vanity bathroom, and panoramic bay views.

rooms.name: Oceanfront Luxury Villa
rooms.description: Ultra-exclusive private villa with direct beach access, private plunge pool, 2 master bedrooms, full kitchen, and personalized concierge service.

amenities.name: Infinity Swimming Pool
amenities.details: Heated outdoor oceanfront infinity pool with complimentary loungers, towels, and poolside cocktail service.

amenities.name: Fitness & Wellness Center
amenities.details: State-of-the-art gym equipped with Technogym cardio machines, free weights, yoga studio, and steam saunas.

amenities.name: Azure Spa
amenities.details: Full-service luxury spa offering aromatherapy, deep tissue massage, facials, and hydrotherapy pools.

amenities.name: High-Speed Wi-Fi
amenities.details: Complimentary ultra-fast Wi-Fi available throughout all guest rooms, public areas, and beach loungers.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.details: Valet parking available at $25/night with EV charging stations included. Self-parking available at $15/night.

breakfast.details: Complimentary gourmet breakfast buffet featuring fresh bakery items, made-to-order omelets, tropical fruits, artisan coffee, and vegan options.

restaurants.name: The Wave Oceanfront Bistro
restaurants.details: Fine dining restaurant serving fresh local seafood, organic steaks, and handcrafted cocktails overlooking the ocean.

restaurants.name: Sunset Pool Lounge
restaurants.details: Casual outdoor bar and lounge serving wood-fired pizzas, fresh salads, craft beer, and tropical cocktails.

policies.check_in: Check-in starts at 3:00 PM. Early check-in can be requested and is subject to room availability upon arrival.
policies.check_out: Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Late check-out up to 2:00 PM is available for a fee of $50 upon request at reception.
policies.cancellation: Free cancellation is permitted up to 48 hours prior to the scheduled check-in date. Cancellations within 48 hours incur a fee equivalent to 1 night's stay.
policies.pets: Pets under 35 lbs are welcome in designated pet-friendly rooms with a non-refundable cleaning fee of $75 per stay. Service animals stay free.
policies.smoking: Harbor View Hotel is a 100% non-smoking property. Smoking in guest rooms or balconies will result in a $250 deep cleaning fee.
policies.children: Children of all ages are welcome. Children under 12 stay free when using existing bedding.

faqs.question: Does the hotel provide airport transportation?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer airport shuttle service to/from Harbor Bay International Airport for $35 per guest. Private luxury sedan transfers can also be arranged through our concierge.

faqs.question: Can I store my luggage before check-in or after check-out?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Luggage storage is available free of charge at the front desk 24 hours a day.

faqs.question: Is room service available?
faqs.answer: Yes, 24-hour in-room dining is available from our restaurant menu.
